title: Test — Quests
body:
This page demonstrates the `[!quest]` callout: title = quest name, objectives = a normal GFM checklist, and status (Not Started / Active / Complete) is derived automatically from how many objectives are checked. Objective lines can also carry inline entity references — try clicking the `npc`/`location` chips below.

> [!quest]+ Find the Missing Shipment
> A caravan bound for the coast never arrived. Something — or someone — got to it first.
>
> - [ ] Question the dockhands about the caravan's last known route
> - [ ] Search the warehouse for signs of forced entry
> - [ ] Track down `npc:Berosalia Hart`, the caravan's broker

> [!quest]+ Secure Passage to Duskvol
> The party needs safe passage into `location:Duskvol` before word of the missing shipment spreads.
>
> - [x] Bribe the harbor watch
> - [x] Forge a set of travel papers
> - [ ] Book passage on a ship not tied to the smugglers

> [!quest]+ Deliver the Sealed Letter
> A simple courier job — deliver `npc:Berosalia Hart`'s letter, no questions asked.
>
> - [x] Retrieve the letter from the drop point
> - [x] Avoid the city watch's checkpoints
> - [x] Hand the letter off in `location:Duskvol`

Quest titles are linkable too — this sentence links directly to [[Find the Missing Shipment]], which resolves straight to the quest above (not a page), since nothing on this workspace shares that title as a page.
